myApplications.title: My applications
myApplications.emptyTitle: You have not applied to any table
myApplications.emptyDescription: Browse the open tables and apply to the one you like.
myApplications.withdrawDescription: Your application to {{name}} will be withdrawn. To try again you will have to apply from scratch, and you lose your place in the queue.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.emptyDescription: Nobody has applied to this table yet.
candidates.order: The order is by application date and is never re-sorted
candidates.rejectDialogDescription: This cannot be undone. Explain why you are turning them down.
candidates.acceptConfirmDefault: Do you confirm this candidate joins the table?
candidates.acceptConfirmFillsTable: This acceptance fills the last seat: every remaining candidate will be rejected automatically.

veto.blockDialogDescription: Say why. It is recorded, and it is what you will read if you ever lift the ban.
veto.blockEffect: They stop seeing this table: it leaves their explorer, they cannot open it and they cannot download its files. They keep their account and every other table they play at.
veto.blockSuccess: {{name}} is now banned from this table
veto.requestDialogDescription: As a co-master, what you send is a request. Say why: it is what the table’s master reads to decide.
veto.requestEffect: Nothing changes yet: the person keeps playing and keeps seeing the table until the master answers.
veto.requestSuccess: Request sent: the table’s master answers it
veto.unblockDialogDescription: They see the table again and go back to where they stood before the ban. Say why you are lifting it: it is recorded just like the ban.
veto.unblockEffect: They get the table back as it was: it returns to their explorer, they can open it, download its files again, and they recover the place they held before the ban.

errors.NOT_PRIMARY_MASTER: The table’s master decides this. As a co-master, what you can do is ask for it.
errors.REGISTRATION_ALREADY_BLOCKED: That person is already banned from this table. Refresh to see how it stands.
errors.REGISTRATION_NOT_BLOCKED: That person is not banned: somebody lifted it before you did.
errors.generic: We could not complete the action. Try again.
